description:
Computes the decompression plan for one dive, open circuit (OC) or closed-circuit rebreather (CCR): stop table, runtime, time to surface (TTS), gas used per cylinder, ascent pressure, CNS/OTU, gas density, warnings, contingencies, CCR bailout and a Dive Kit share link. Defaults unless given: GF 50/80, reserve thirds, SAC 20/15 L/min, last stop 6 m (20 ft), EN 13319 water, sea level. Use this when a diver wants a deco schedule, the gas a planned dive needs, or a what-if comparison (deeper, longer, a lost gas, other gradient factors) on air, nitrox or trimix. Not for: MOD, END or other gas facts at one depth (gas_specs), a best mix (best_mix), the longest bottom time the gas allows (find_max_bottom_time), no-stop time (check_no_deco), or dive logging.

Computed by Dive Kit's Bühlmann ZH-L16C engine. Results are an experimental planning aid: relay the safety_notice.

plan_name labels it ("45m 20min 21/35+EANx50"); audience (beginner, recreational, technical) tunes wording. A cylinder takes a preset (al80, twin_12l, stage_11l …; lookup_cylinders finds others) or cylinder_size and start_pressure; missing ones default to an AL80 (11.1 L at 3000 psi, 206.84 bar). descent_gas names a travel gas for a hypoxic bottom mix. scenarios compares what-ifs in one call: deeper_3m, longer_3min, lost:<id>, gf:40/85, last_stop:3.

`units` sets every depth, pressure, volume, rate and temperature: metric (m, bar, L) or imperial (ft, psi, ft³). PPO₂ is always bar, mixes %, times minutes.

Omit any other field for its Dive Kit default; the result lists each default it applied. get_guide('inputs_reference') lists every field, get_guide('workflow') the planning conversation. Stateless: send the whole plan every call.

Example: {"plan_name":"45m 20min 21/35+EANx50","levels":[{"depth":45,"bottom_time_min":20}],"cylinders":[{"id":"back","oxygen_pct":21,"helium_pct":35,"preset":"twin_12l","start_pressure":220},{"id":"deco","oxygen_pct":50,"preset":"stage_11l"}],"scenarios":["base","gf:40/85"]}

audience.description: Optional: who the answer is for, from the conversation. beginner: new to deco, plain words. recreational (default): some training. technical: trained deco or CCR diver, terms and tables. Shapes the wording only, never a number.

depth.description: For on_ascent: depth (m or ft) the diver leaves the loop on the final ascent.

level_number.description: For after_level: the level (1-based) the diver bails at the end of.

run_time_min.description: For at_run_time: minutes on the Run clock.

view.description: ccr: which ascent the table shows. loop (default), end_of_profile, after_level, at_run_time, on_ascent. The worst-case bailout check runs on every view.

include_travel_in_level_time.description: true: level time includes the descent to it (dive-computer runtime style). Default false.

o2_narcotic.description: Count oxygen in END. END and warnings only. Default false.

stay_on_loop.description: ccr: true (default) keeps the whole ascent on the loop; false lets an OC deco gas take over where its PPO₂ is higher. Not carried in share links.

descent_switch_depth.description: Depth (m or ft) where the descent setpoint hands over to bottom, first descent only. Default 18 m (60 ft).

diluent_breathable_oc.description: true if the BOV or a regulator can breathe the onboard diluent open circuit. It then joins the bailout pool last. Default false.

diluent_size.description: Diluent cylinder: litres (metric) or ft³ rated at 3000 psi (imperial). Default 3 L.

diluent_start_pressure.description: Diluent cylinder fill (bar or psi). Default 232 bar (3365 psi).

loop_volume.description: Loop volume, litres in both unit systems, 2 to 15. Default 6.

o2_size.description: Oxygen cylinder: litres (metric) or ft³ rated at 3000 psi (imperial). Default 3 L.

o2_start_pressure.description: Oxygen cylinder fill (bar or psi). Default 232 bar (3365 psi).

bottom.description: Bottom setpoint in bar, the level default. Default 1.0.

deco.description: Deco setpoint in bar, used where ccr_deco_schedule has no step. Default 1.4.

ccr_deco_schedule.description: ccr deco setpoint steps, up to 10. Default [40 m: 1.5, 23 m: 1.6]. Send [] for the single ccr.setpoints.deco.

depth.description: Depth (m or ft): the step applies at this depth and shallower.

ccr_dilout_switches.description: ccr: at each depth and shallower, the loop breathes that cylinder as diluent (a dilout). Up to 6. Default none.

cylinder.description: Cylinder id breathed as diluent, or "onboard" to switch back.

depth.description: Depth (m or ft): the switch applies at this depth and shallower.

contingencies.description: Custom contingencies, up to 6, each requested with scenarios "custom:<name>" (or "all").

deco_sac.description: Deco SAC for this contingency only (L/min or ft³/min, per units). Default gas_consumption.deco_sac.

delay_min.description: A hold at depth before the ascent starts, 0 to 60 minutes. Moves the schedule. Default 0.

depth_change.description: Depth added to that level (m or ft, per units), -30 to 30 m (-100 to 100 ft). Default 0.

fails_after_level.description: Level number (1-based) after which the lost cylinders are gone. Omit: they are never carried.

level_number.description: Level number (1-based) the depth and time changes apply to. Default the deepest (last on a tie).

lost_cylinders.description: Cylinder ids lost in this contingency, comma-separated, e.g. "s50,o2". Default none.

name.description: Name of this contingency, 1 to 24 characters. Request it with scenarios "custom:<name>". Unique.

stress_minutes.description: Minutes the stress_sac burst lasts, 1 to 60.

stress_sac.description: Hard-breathing surface rate, SAC (L/min or ft³/min, per units), from the end of the bottom (on bailout: from leaving the loop), gas only. Needs stress_minutes or stress_whole_ascent.

stress_whole_ascent.description: true: the stress_sac burst lasts to the surface. Default false.

time_change_min.description: Minutes added to that level, -60 to 60. Default 0.

working_sac.description: Working SAC for this contingency only (L/min or ft³/min, per units). Default gas_consumption.working_sac.

cylinders.description: Every open-circuit cylinder carried: back gas, stages, deco gases; on ccr, bailout gases. 1 to 10. Give preset or cylinder_size and start_pressure when known; omitted ones default (an AL80, 11.1 L at 3000 psi) and the result marks them.

cylinder_size.description: 12 = one 12 L cylinder (metric). 77.4 = an AL80 in ft³ (imperial, with rated_pressure 3000). Metric: water volume of ONE cylinder in litres, the number stamped on the neck, 1 to 25.5. Imperial: rated capacity in ft³ from the spec sheet (an AL80 holds less than its name), 1 to 400. Or pass preset. Default with neither: an AL80 (11.1 L, 77.4 ft³ at 3000 psi).

exclude_from_deco.description: true keeps this cylinder out of automatic ascent switching (pony, buddy bottle). Still priced; a level can still name it. Default false.

helium_pct.description: Helium percent, 0 to 95, oxygen_pct + helium_pct at most 100. Trimix 18/45 is 45. Default 0.

id.description: Short name used by levels and contingencies, 1 to 12 letters, digits, _ or -, e.g. back, s50, o2. Unique.

oxygen_pct.description: Oxygen percent, 5 to 100. Air is 21, EANx50 is 50, trimix 18/45 is 18.

preset.description: A common cylinder instead of cylinder_size, rated_pressure, twinset and the fill (explicit fields win). al80/s80: aluminium 80, 11.1 L, 3000 psi. al40, al63: aluminium 40/63, 3000 psi. hp80, hp100, hp120: US high-pressure steel, 3442 psi. lp85: US low-pressure steel, 2640 psi. single_10l, single_12l, single_15l: one EU steel cylinder at 232 bar. twin_10l, twin_12l, twin_15l: back-mounted doubles, 232 bar each. stage_11l: aluminium stage (AL80 size), 200 bar. stage_7l: 7 L stage, 200 bar. o2_3l, dil_3l: 3 L rebreather cylinder, 232 bar.

rated_pressure.description: Imperial only: the working pressure the capacity is rated at, psi, 725 to 7252 (3000 for an AL80). Default: the preset's, else 3000. Ignored on metric.

reserve_pressure.description: Custom reserve for this cylinder (bar or psi, per units), 5 to 300 bar (50 to 4351 psi). Default: the reserve rule. Moves warnings and find_max_bottom_time, never the stops.

start_pressure.description: Pressure in the cylinder at the start of the dive (bar or psi, per units), 0 to 500 bar (0 to 7252 psi). Default: the preset's fill, else 206.84 bar (3000 psi).

twinset.description: true for back-mounted doubles or a sidemount pair breathed as one supply: doubles the gas at the same pressure. Default: the preset's, else false.

descent_gas.description: oc only. Cylinder id of a travel gas for the descent, for a hypoxic bottom mix (e.g. 12/60) that cannot be breathed near the surface. When level 1 is deeper than that gas's MOD, a 0-minute level on it at its MOD (whole m or ft) is added before level 1, and the result numbers that level first. Default none.

altitude.description: Surface altitude (m or ft, per units), 0 to 10000 m (0 to 32800 ft). Default 0.

temperature.description: Water temperature for gas density only, -2 to 40 °C (28 to 104 °F). Never moves stops. Default 15 °C (59 °F).

water.description: Water type, from its density: en13319 (EN 13319, the dive computer standard) 10.00 m per bar, salt 9.95, fresh 10.20, red_sea 9.92. Default en13319.

ccr_metabolic_o2.description: ccr: oxygen the diver metabolises, L/min in both unit systems, 0.4 to 2.0. Default 0.85.

deco_sac.description: SAC from the first stop up (L/min or ft³/min). Default 15 L/min (0.53 ft³/min). Gas figures only.

working_sac.description: Surface air consumption (SAC, also called RMV) for descent, bottom and the deep ascent (L/min or ft³/min, per units), 1 to 200 L/min (0.05 to 7.1 ft³/min). Default 20 L/min (0.71 ft³/min). Gas figures only.

switch_at.description: mod: switch at the deco gas MOD (default). stop: at the next stop.

switch_time_s.description: Seconds held at each OC switch on the old gas, 0 to 300 in 30 s steps. Default 0.

when_cylinder_empty.description: show_shortfall (default): stay on it and report how much more gas is needed. switch_gas: move to the richest safe gas left.

gradient_factors.description: Gradient factors. Lower is more conservative. Default 50/80. If high cannot surface the plan, the engine raises it and warns.

high.description: GF high, percent, 10 to 100. Sets the shallow stops and surfacing margin. Default 80.

low.description: GF low, percent, 10 to 100. Sets the first stop depth. Default 50.

levels.description: Dive levels in the order dived, 1 to 20. The first is level_number 1.

bottom_time_min.description: Minutes at this depth, excluding the descent to it (unless behavior.include_travel_in_level_time is true). 0 to 360. 0 = arrival only: passes through this depth on this gas, used for a no-stop check or a travel-gas leg. Required.

breathe.description: ccr only. loop (default) or oc: dive this level open circuit on `gas`.

depth.description: Level depth (m or ft, per units). 1 to 200 m (3 to 650 ft). Required.

diluent.description: ccr only. "onboard" (default) or a cylinder id to breathe through the loop as a dilout on this level.

gas.description: Cylinder id this level breathes, or "auto" (default): the richest gas legal at this depth by PPO₂ cap, hypoxic floor and density limit. On ccr, auto means the loop on the onboard diluent.

setpoint.description: ccr only. Loop PPO₂ for this level in bar, 0.4 to 1.6. Default ccr.setpoints.bottom.

mode.description: oc (open circuit, default) or ccr (closed-circuit rebreather). Set ccr for every rebreather plan: the ccr, ccr_deco_schedule, ccr_dilout_switches and bailout fields need it. On ccr, `cylinders` are the open-circuit bailout gases; the rig itself is in `ccr`.

modifiers.description: Plan modifiers: a stress breathing burst (gas only) and a delay before the ascent (moves the schedule).

deco_sac.description: Deco SAC override for the whole plan (L/min or ft³/min). Default gas_consumption.deco_sac.

delay_min.description: A hold at depth before the ascent starts, 0 to 60 minutes. Moves the schedule. Default 0.

stress_minutes.description: Minutes the stress_sac burst lasts, 1 to 60.

stress_sac.description: Hard-breathing surface rate, SAC (L/min or ft³/min, per units), from the end of the bottom (on bailout: from leaving the loop), gas only. Needs stress_minutes or stress_whole_ascent.

stress_whole_ascent.description: true: the stress_sac burst lasts to the surface. Default false.

working_sac.description: Working SAC override for the whole plan (L/min or ft³/min). Default gas_consumption.working_sac.

apply_on_loop.description: ccr: also break on the loop. Not carried in share links. Default false.

break_minutes.description: Break length in minutes, 1 to 10. Default 5.

enabled.description: Insert oxygen breaks on high-PPO₂ stops. Default false.

loop_setpoint.description: ccr: loop setpoint in bar during a break. Default 0.7.

min_ppo2.description: PPO₂ in bar at or above which a stop counts toward the break clock, 0.8 to 1.8. Default 1.4.

o2_minutes.description: Minutes on high PPO₂ before a break, 5 to 30. Default 20.

plan_name.description: Short human label shown in the approval card; fill it first, e.g. 40m 20min air+EANx50. Also titles the plan table and share link, which keep its first 24 characters (a longer name is cut, never refused).

max_28_to_44pct_o2.description: PPO₂ cap in bar for gases from 28% to under 45% O₂, 1.0 to 1.6. Default 1.5.

max_45pct_o2_and_up.description: PPO₂ cap in bar for gases of 45% O₂ and over, 1.0 to 1.6. Default 1.6.

max_all.description: One PPO₂ cap in bar for every gas, 1.0 to 1.6 (e.g. 1.4 for recreational nitrox). Sets all three bands; a band field given too wins for its band.

max_under_28pct_o2.description: PPO₂ cap in bar for gases under 28% O₂, 1.0 to 1.6. Sets their MOD and switch depth. Default 1.4.

min.description: Lowest PPO₂ in bar before a hypoxia warning, 0.16 to 0.21. Warnings only. Default 0.18.

rates.description: Ascent and descent rates, per units.

ascent_deep.description: Ascent rate below rate_change_depth (m/min or ft/min), 1 to 100 m/min. Default 9 m/min (30 ft/min).

ascent_shallow.description: Ascent rate from rate_change_depth to the surface (m/min or ft/min), 1 to 100 m/min. Default 3 m/min (10 ft/min).

descent.description: Descent rate (m/min or ft/min), 1 to 100 m/min. Default 20 m/min (66 ft/min).

rate_change_depth.description: Depth where the ascent rate changes (m or ft), 3 to 200 m. Default 6 m (20 ft).

repetitive.description: Repetitive dive: the previous dive and the surface interval.

previous_share_url.description: The share link of the previous dive's plan_dive result. Its tissue loading seeds this dive.

surface_interval_min.description: Surface interval since the previous dive, 15 to 1440 minutes.

reserve.description: Gas reserve rule. Moves the gas status and warnings, never the stops.

fixed_pressure.description: Reserve for rule fixed (bar or psi, per units). Default 50 bar (725 psi).

rule.description: thirds, fourths, fifths, sixths or fixed. Default thirds. Below 50 bar (725 psi) is always critical.

response_format.description: concise: plan table, gas, warnings, scenario summary. detailed: adds every setting used, per-level NDL, full warning details and the bailout table. Default concise.

scenarios.description: Which plans to compute, default ["base"]. base; deeper_3m, deeper_5m (imperial: deeper_10ft, deeper_20ft), longer_3min, longer_5min, deeper_and_longer_3, deeper_and_longer_5 (applied to the deepest level); lost:<cylinder id> (that cylinder never carried); custom:<name> (defined in contingencies); gf:<low>/<high> (e.g. gf:40/85), last_stop:<depth> (3, 4.5, 6 m or 10, 15, 20 ft) and stop_rounding:<1s|30s|1min> (the base plan with that one setting changed, to compare settings in one call); all (not the variants). Each one returns its own table and a comparison row. Up to 10. Ask for more in a later call.

last_stop_depth.description: Final stop depth: 3, 4.5 or 6 m; 10, 15 or 20 ft. Default 6 m (20 ft).

stop_spacing.description: Distance between stops: 3, 6 or 9 m; 10, 20 or 30 ft. Default 3 m (10 ft).

time_rounding.description: 1s, 30s or 1min. Applied inside the engine; a stop is never shorter than the obligation. Default 1min.

table_columns.description: Extra table columns. PPO₂ is always shown.

cns.description: Add a running CNS column. Default false.

gas_remaining.description: Add a gas-remaining column (bar or psi). Default false.

units.description: metric (m, bar, L, L/min, °C) or imperial (ft, psi, ft³, ft³/min, °F). Applies to every input and output value except PPO₂/setpoints (bar), mixes (%), density (g/L). Default metric.

warning_thresholds.description: Warning thresholds. Warnings only, never the stops.

density_critical.description: Gas density critical in g/L, 3 to 8; also vetoes a gas in auto. Default 6.2.

density_warning.description: Gas density warning in g/L, 3 to 8. Default 5.2.

end_max.description: Highest END before a warning (m or ft, per units), 20 to 100 m. Default 30 m (100 ft).

name: plan_dive

loop_warnings.description: ccr bailout views only: warnings for the loop plan the summary and main table show, with the per-level issues. warnings then covers the bailout view.

level_number.description: 1-based level a per-level issue belongs to.

gas_line.description: response_format detailed: what each cylinder ends with in this scenario.

shortfall.description: Every cylinder that runs short and by how much ("travel 41 bar"), or "none".

settings_table_markdown.description: The Plan settings table (Setting | Value): every key variable the schedule used, "(default)" after each Dive Kit default.

spoken_summary.description: One paragraph to speak as a dive briefing in a voice conversation: the dive, GF and reserve rule, run time, the stops that matter, gas per key cylinder, every critical issue, an offer to re-run. Units in words, no symbols or notation, at most 700 characters.

warnings.description: Plan warnings, most severe first, including per-level issues (with level_number) not already stated.

level_number.description: 1-based level a per-level issue belongs to.

title: Plan a decompression dive
